title: Here in Hollywood: How a Tacloban-born Fil-Am chef highlighted bagoong in his menu and earned a Michelin star
summary: For Chef Patrick Gabon, the road to a Michelin star began thousands of miles from San Francisco, in Tacloban, a coastal city in the Eastern Visayas region of the Philippines.
